//: Type-check the dashboard's JS slices without a build step: `npx -p typescript tsc -p jsconfig.json` (scripts/check-js.sh, part of scripts/gate.sh). The ten slices are plain scripts sharing one global scope, so tsc sees them as one program and reports a name used in one slice but defined in none — the class of bug that once aborted 01-core.js at load (a registry entry referencing a loader from a later slice). Loose on purpose: no implicit-any errors, no strict null checks; what it must catch is undefined names, wrong call shapes and typos.
